items.title_zh: 让智能体帮你购物，OpenAI 推出支付功能 ChatGPT Wallet
items.title_en: OpenAI launches payment feature ChatGPT Wallet, letting agents shop for users
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，OpenAI 今天（13 日）宣布推出支付功能 ChatGPT Wallet，让旗下 dot AI 智能体代替用户购物。 ChatGPT Wallet 由 OpenAI 与美国运通、万事达卡和 Visa 合作开发，用户使用现有信用卡付款时，仍可享受原有的积分奖励和权益保障。符合条件的用户只需录入一次银行卡信息， 随后便可让 dot 智能体帮忙寻找商品，每笔交易都需要通过安全验证才能完成 。 OpenAI 强调，dot 智能体 不会接触用户的真实银行卡信息 。支付网络会为每笔交易生成专用的支付令牌，其中包含 限定用途的卡号、安全码和有效期 ，供智能体完成付款。 当今，越来越多消费者开始尝试用个人 AI 智能体管理日程、预订旅行和处理其他日常事务，ChatGPT Wallet 在这样的背景下应运而生。 ChatGPT Wallet 未来有望成为 OpenAI 新的收入来源。初期不会向交易收取佣金，OpenAI 当前的目标是更希望与商家建立合作关系，让消费者逐渐 将 ChatGPT 视为购物平台 ，尤其是在商家也开始探索个人 AI 智能体的用途之际。 ChatGPT Wallet 初期仅向美国年满 18 岁的 OpenAI Pro 订阅用户开放。 据IT之家了解，截至今年第三季度末，ChatGPT 每周活跃用户超过 12 亿，付费用户接近 1 亿 。 OpenAI 指出，利用 AI 智能体购物仍处于起步阶段。公司在发布 ChatGPT Wallet 的同时，还推出了面向企业的工具和指南，帮助商家适应这种变化，其中就包括 如何检查网站是否误拦截了 OpenAI 的智能体 。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that OpenAI announced the launch of the payment feature ChatGPT Wallet today (the 13th), letting its dot AI agent shop on users’ behalf. ChatGPT Wallet was developed by OpenAI with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa; when users pay with existing credit cards, they can still enjoy their original rewards and protections. Eligible users need to enter their bank card information once, after which they can ask the dot agent to help find products, and every transaction must pass security verification. OpenAI emphasized that the dot agent will not touch users’ real bank card information. The payment network generates a dedicated payment token for each transaction, including a limited-use card number, security code, and expiration date, for the agent to complete payment. As more consumers try personal AI agents to manage schedules, book travel, and handle other daily tasks, ChatGPT Wallet arrives in this context. ChatGPT Wallet is expected to become a new revenue source for OpenAI in the future. Initially, no commission will be charged on transactions; OpenAI’s current goal is to build merchant partnerships and gradually make consumers view ChatGPT as a shopping platform, especially as merchants also begin exploring uses for personal AI agents. ChatGPT Wallet is initially available only to OpenAI Pro subscribers aged 18 and over in the United States. According to IT之家, by the end of the third quarter this year, ChatGPT had more than 1.2 billion weekly active users and nearly 100 million paid users. OpenAI noted that shopping with AI agents is still in its early stages. Along with ChatGPT Wallet, the company also launched enterprise-facing tools and guides to help merchants adapt to this change, including how to check whether a website mistakenly blocks OpenAI’s agents.
items.why_zh: 推测：若支付令牌与验证机制按描述落地，这可能推动 AI 智能体从信息助手走向实际交易入口，并影响电商流量与支付合作格局。
items.why_en: Speculative: if the payment-token and verification mechanisms work as described, this could move AI agents from information assistants toward actual transaction gateways and affect e-commerce traffic and payment partnerships.

items.title_zh: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO，或给 Anthropic 下周“史上最大 IPO”添变数
items.title_en: Report: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, potentially complicating Anthropic’s ‘largest-ever IPO’ next week
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，当地时间 12 日，据《财富》杂志报道，AI 初创企业 Anthropic 即将迎来史上最受瞩目的 IPO 之一。然而，就在上市前夕，英伟达联合创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋突然辞职。 等到 Anthropic 正式登陆资本市场时，距离 AI 行业失去最有影响力、最擅长推销行业前景的人物之一， 仅过去一周 。 黄仁勋突然离职，给 Anthropic 的上市计划增添了新的压力。 此次 IPO 原本就被视为检验投资者对 AI 投资热情的重要考验。Anthropic 预计于 11 月 18 或 19 日上市 ，届时英伟达刚公布黄仁勋卸任 CEO 后的首份季度财报。 英伟达不仅是 Anthropic 的重要合作伙伴，也深度参与此次 IPO。Anthropic 提交的文件显示，英伟达同意在与 IPO 同步进行的 260 亿美元私募配售中认购约 100 亿美元股份。 两家公司还有密切的业务联系，Anthropic 承诺斥资数百亿美元，确保能够 使用英伟达最先进的芯片 。 多名投资者和分析师指出，虽然英伟达的人事变动预计不会影响 Anthropic 的核心业务，但可能 动摇市场对整个 AI 行业的信心 。 Seaport Research Partners 分析师杰伊 · 戈德堡，华尔街少数给予英伟达股票卖出评级的人士之一。他认为，黄仁勋离职 不会影响 Anthropic 上市 ：“他们上市时正好赶上英伟达公布财报，我不认为这会打乱上市计划。这次 IPO 规模实在太大，参与的人又太多，他们不会撤回。” 戈德堡更担心 Anthropic 上市后的处境 。在黄仁勋正式辞职前，外界就传出他可能离职的消息。 戈德堡当时警告，英伟达发生动荡，尤其是失去 CEO，将给 Anthropic 发布上市后的首份季度财报带来压力。“至少，市场会开始质疑：‘ AI 热潮还能持续吗？还能照这样发展下去吗？ ’Anthropic 将面临更加尖锐的质询。” 风险投资公司 M13 合伙人卡尔 · 阿洛马同样认为，Anthropic 的基本面没有改变：“在我看来，Anthropic 的处境和消息传出前一样好，实力也一样强。Anthropic 的财务数据非常出色，而且显然拥有超出自身需求的算力储备。他们并没有花那么多钱。” 与部分竞争对手相比，Anthropic 对英伟达的依赖也较小 。除了英伟达的硬件，Anthropic 还使用谷歌 TPU、亚马逊 Trainium 芯片和 AMD GPU 运行部分 AI 模型。据报道，Anthropic 还在考虑自行研发芯片。 曾在沃顿商学院任教的会计师兼调查记者弗朗辛 · 麦肯纳认为，英伟达对 Anthropic 的投资承诺 很可能不受影响 ：“英伟达承诺在 Anthropic 上市时投资 100 亿美元。等到 IPO 真正启动，这笔投资很可能还是会落实。但如果有人指望英伟达在必要时出手救助 CoreWeave，恐怕得另找靠山了。” 不过，乔治城大学麦克多诺商学院副教授杰森 · 施洛策认为，英伟达最近遭遇的风波，以及外界对黄仁勋判断力的质疑，也可能 让合作伙伴受到更严格的审查 。他预计，市场将更加仔细地审视 Anthropic 与英伟达及英伟达客户之间的联系。 在硅谷，Anthropic 和竞争对手 OpenAI 的融资需求极其庞大， 几乎所有风投公司 都持有两家公司的股份，使两家公司在私募市场上的地位近似于指数基金。 因此，Anthropic 预计下周进行的 IPO 将成为一场 举足轻重的投资变现机会 ，不仅关系到超过 400 名投资者的利益，也关系到整个 AI 热潮的前景。 市场普遍认为，如果 Anthropic 成功上市，AI 热潮就还有很大的发展空间；如果上市失败或无限期推迟，则将明确释放出 AI 泡沫接近破裂的负面信号 。 不过，黄仁勋离职未必会让 Anthropic 上市受挫。至少有一名风险投资人认为，Anthropic 反而可能受益。双方在 AI 监管方面也有分歧，黄仁勋尤其反对 可能增加客户使用开源 AI 模型难度的许可要求 。 一名匿名风险投资人认为：“真要说有什么影响，我反而觉得 Anthropic 会从中受益。他们跟黄仁勋的关系本来就没那么密切……Anthropic 还在开发自己的芯片，因此供…
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that, according to Fortune on the 12th local time, AI startup Anthropic is about to see one of the most closely watched IPOs in history. However, on the eve of listing, Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang suddenly resigned. By the time Anthropic formally enters the capital market, only a week will have passed since the AI industry lost one of its most influential figures and one of the best at selling the industry’s prospects. Huang’s sudden departure adds new pressure to Anthropic’s listing plan. The IPO was already seen as an important test of investors’ enthusiasm for AI investment. Anthropic is expected to list on November 18 or 19, just as Nvidia reports its first quarterly earnings after Huang stepped down as CEO. Nvidia is not only an important partner of Anthropic but also deeply involved in the IPO. Anthropic’s filings show that Nvidia agreed to subscribe to about $10 billion of shares in a $26 billion private placement concurrent with the IPO. The two companies also have close business ties: Anthropic has committed tens of billions of dollars to ensure access to Nvidia’s most advanced chips. Several investors and analysts noted that while Nvidia’s personnel change is not expected to affect Anthropic’s core business, it could shake market confidence in the entire AI industry. Seaport Research Partners analyst Jay Goldberg is one of the few on Wall Street with a sell rating on Nvidia. He believes Huang’s departure will not affect Anthropic’s listing: 'They are listing right when Nvidia reports earnings; I don’t think this will disrupt the listing plan. This IPO is simply too large, and too many people are involved; they will not withdraw.' Goldberg is more worried about Anthropic’s situation after listing. Before Huang formally resigned, there had already been reports that he might leave. Goldberg warned at the time that turmoil at Nvidia, especially losing its CEO, would put pressure on Anthropic’s first quarterly report after listing. 'At the very least, the market will begin to ask: Can the AI boom continue? Can it keep developing this way? Anthropic will face sharper questioning.' Karl Alomar, a partner at venture capital firm M13, likewise believes Anthropic’s fundamentals have not changed: 'In my view, Anthropic’s situation is as good and as strong as it was before the news came out. Anthropic’s financial data is excellent, and it clearly has compute reserves beyond its own needs. They have not spent that much.' Compared with some competitors, Anthropic is also less dependent on Nvidia. In addition to Nvidia hardware, Anthropic uses Google TPUs, Amazon Trainium chips, and AMD GPUs to run some AI models. According to reports, Anthropic is also considering developing its own chips. Accountant and investigative journalist Francine McKenna, who formerly taught at Wharton, believes Nvidia’s investment commitment to Anthropic is likely unaffected: 'Nvidia promised to invest $10 billion when Anthropic lists. When the IPO actually starts, that investment will likely still happen. But if anyone expects Nvidia to rescue CoreWeave if necessary, they had better look elsewhere.' However, Jason Schloetzer, an associate professor at Georgetown University’s McDonough School of Business, believes Nvidia’s recent turmoil and doubts about Huang’s judgment could also lead partners to face stricter scrutiny. He expects the market to examine more carefully the ties between Anthropic and Nvidia and Nvidia’s customers. In Silicon Valley, Anthropic and rival OpenAI have enormous fundraising needs, and almost all venture capital firms hold shares in both companies, making their position in the private market resemble index funds. Therefore, Anthropic’s IPO expected next week will be a major liquidity event, affecting not only the interests of more than 400 investors but also the prospects of the entire AI boom. The market widely believes that if Anthropic lists successfully, the AI boom still has considerable room to grow; if the listing fails or is delayed indefinitely, it would clearly send a negative signal that the AI bubble is close to bursting. However, Huang’s departure may not necessarily hurt Anthropic’s listing. At least one venture investor believes Anthropic may actually benefit. The two sides also differ on AI regulation; Huang especially opposes licensing requirements that could make it harder for customers to use open-source AI models. items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，当地时间 12 日，据《财富》杂志报道，AI 初创企业 Anthropic 即将迎来史上最受瞩目的 IPO 之一。然而，就在上市前夕，英伟达联合创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋突然辞职。 等到 Anthropic 正式登陆资本市场时，距离 AI 行业失去最有影响力、最擅长推销行业前景的人物之一， 仅过去一周 。 黄仁勋突然离职，给 Anthropic 的上市计划增添了新的压力。 此次 IPO 原本就被视为检验投资者对 AI 投资热情的重要考验。Anthropic 预计于 11 月 18 或 19 日上市 ，届时英伟达刚公布黄仁勋卸任 CEO 后的首份季度财报。 英伟达不仅是 Anthropic 的重要合作伙伴，也深度参与此次 IPO。Anthropic 提交的文件显示，英伟达同意在与 IPO 同步进行的 260 亿美元私募配售中认购约 100 亿美元股份。 两家公司还有密切的业务联系，Anthropic 承诺斥资数百亿美元，确保能够 使用英伟达最先进的芯片 。 多名投资者和分析师指出，虽然英伟达的人事变动预计不会影响 Anthropic 的核心业务，但可能 动摇市场对整个 AI 行业的信心 。 Seaport Research Partners 分析师杰伊 · 戈德堡，华尔街少数给予英伟达股票卖出评级的人士之一。他认为，黄仁勋离职 不会影响 Anthropic 上市 ：“他们上市时正好赶上英伟达公布财报，我不认为这会打乱上市计划。这次 IPO 规模实在太大，参与的人又太多，他们不会撤回。” 戈德堡更担心 Anthropic 上市后的处境 。在黄仁勋正式辞职前，外界就传出他可能离职的消息。 戈德堡当时警告，英伟达发生动荡，尤其是失去 CEO，将给 Anthropic 发布上市后的首份季度财报带来压力。“至少，市场会开始质疑：‘ AI 热潮还能持续吗？还能照这样发展下去吗？ ’Anthropic 将面临更加尖锐的质询。” 风险投资公司 M13 合伙人卡尔 · 阿洛马同样认为，Anthropic 的基本面没有改变：“在我看来，Anthropic 的处境和消息传出前一样好，实力也一样强。Anthropic 的财务数据非常出色，而且显然拥有超出自身需求的算力储备。他们并没有花那么多钱。” 与部分竞争对手相比，Anthropic 对英伟达的依赖也较小 。除了英伟达的硬件，Anthropic 还使用谷歌 TPU、亚马逊 Trainium 芯片和 AMD GPU 运行部分 AI 模型。据报道，Anthropic 还在考虑自行研发芯片。 曾在沃顿商学院任教的会计师兼调查记者弗朗辛 · 麦肯纳认为，英伟达对 Anthropic 的投资承诺 很可能不受影响 ：“英伟达承诺在 Anthropic 上市时投资 100 亿美元。等到 IPO 真正启动，这笔投资很可能还是会落实。但如果有人指望英伟达在必要时出手救助 CoreWeave，恐怕得另找靠山了。” 不过，乔治城大学麦克多诺商学院副教授杰森 · 施洛策认为，英伟达最近遭遇的风波，以及外界对黄仁勋判断力的质疑，也可能 让合作伙伴受到更严格的审查 。他预计，市场将更加仔细地审视 Anthropic 与英伟达及英伟达客户之间的联系。 在硅谷，Anthropic 和竞争对手 OpenAI 的融资需求极其庞大， 几乎所有风投公司 都持有两家公司的股份，使两家公司在私募市场上的地位近似于指数基金。 因此，Anthropic 预计下周进行的 IPO 将成为一场 举足轻重的投资变现机会 ，不仅关系到超过 400 名投资者的利益，也关系到整个 AI 热潮的前景。 市场普遍认为，如果 Anthropic 成功上市，AI 热潮就还有很大的发展空间；如果上市失败或无限期推迟，则将明确释放出 AI 泡沫接近破裂的负面信号 。 不过，黄仁勋离职未必会让 Anthropic 上市受挫。至少有一名风险投资人认为，Anthropic 反而可能受益。双方在 AI 监管方面也有分歧，黄仁勋尤其反对 可能增加客户使用开源 AI 模型难度的许可要求 。 一名匿名风险投资人认为：“真要说有什么影响，我反而觉得 Anthropic 会从中受益。他们跟黄仁勋的关系本来就没那么密切……Anthropic 还在开发自己的芯片，因此供…

items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that at the September 7 HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2 and all-scenario new product launch, HarmonyOS 7 was officially released. At the event, Huawei also teased a new feature: the Xiaoyi AI Quick Bar. The official PPT page showed that once enabled, Xiaoyi will stay in the Dock at the bottom of the phone desktop. In October this year, Huawei customer service said the feature was expected to roll out gradually in late October or early November. IT之家 asked again today about the rollout time, and customer service provided a more detailed schedule: mid-November 2026, HUAWEI Mate 90, Mate 90 Pro, Mate 90 RS, and Pura X View; December 2026 (first batch), phones include the Mate 80 series, Pura 90 Pro, Pura 90 Pro Max, Pura 90, Pura X Max series, Mate X7 series, nova 16 Ultra, nova 16 Pro, nova 16, and nova 16z, while tablets include MatePad Mini, MatePad 11.5 2026, MatePad Edge, MatePad Pro Max, HUAWEI MatePad Pro 12-inch 2026, HUAWEI MatePad Air 12-inch (third generation), and HUAWEI MatePad Air Z; December 2026 (second batch), phones include Mate 70, Mate 70 Pro, Mate 70 Pro 优享版, Mate 70 Pro+, Mate 70 RS, Mate 70 Air, Mate X6 series, Pura 80 series, Pura X series, Pura 70, Pura 70 Pro, Pura 70 Pro+, Pura 70 Ultra, Pura 70 北斗卫星消息版, Mate 60, Mate 60 Pro, Mate 60 Pro+, Mate 60 RS | ULTIMATE DESIGN, nova 15 series, and nova 14 series, while tablets include MatePad Pro 13.2 2025, MatePad Pro 12.2 2025, MatePad Air 12 2025, and MatePad 11.5 S 2025; early January 2027, phones include Mate XTs, Mate XT 非凡大师, Mate X5 series, Pocket 2 series, nova Flip series, nova 13 series, nova 12, nova 12 Ultra, nova 12 Ultra 星耀版, and nova 12 Pro, while tablets include MatePad Pro 13.2 2023, MatePad Pro 11 2024, MatePad Pro 12.2 2024, MatePad Air 12 2024, and MatePad 11.5"S 2024. Huawei customer service said that phones, foldables, and tablets with 12GB or more RAM support the AI Quick Bar, and rollout plans for other models will continue to be updated. Related reading: 'Huawei HarmonyOS 7 officially released: a new spatial aesthetic design language, featuring the system agent Xiaoyi.'

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布全家桶应用 API：开发者将能 1:1 复刻完整 DeepSeek App
items.title_en: DeepSeek releases full-suite app API, enabling developers to replicate the complete DeepSeek App 1:1
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，今天（13 日）晚间，DeepSeek 宣布正式开放全家桶应用 API：在原有 API 中开启对应参数， 即可获得深度思考搜索、文件输入等对话功能 ；语音及相关底层能力也已开放独立接口（含 OCR、ASR、TTS 等），支持单独或组合调用。 开发者可以在自己的应用中轻松实现复杂的对话功能， 甚至 1:1 复刻出完整的 DeepSeek App 。 本次更新将 DeepSeek App 的各项交互功能直接整合进原有 API。开启对应参数后，相关工具调用与上下文拼接均由服务端自动完成。 目前，V4.1-Flash 模型（deepseek-flash）已在 Messages、Responses 与 Chat Completions 接口下支持以下能力： 联网搜索： 在非思考模式下，打开 deepseek_web_search 工具后，模型可根据提问自动发起网页或图片搜索并附引用作答； 深度思考搜索： 在思考模式下，打开 deepseek_web_search 工具后，模型可在多步推理中自主联网搜索与阅读链接； 文件输入： 支持上传 PDF、Office、图片等格式的文件，完成纯文本提取或图文混排解析后，拼入对话上下文供模型作答； 阅读链接： 将 deepseek_read_url 工具打开后，模型可自动识别用户消息中的链接，抓取网页内容并结合上下文作答； 模型安全： 开启安全校验参数后，DeepSeek 将提供基础风控，审核模型输入输出，命中风险时返回拒答标识。如您对外提供应用服务，请务必开启该参数，并承担内容安全审核、大模型登记、AI 标识等义务。 此外，为方便开发者更灵活地接入自有工作流，上述底层能力及语音能力 均支持作为独立接口单独调用 ，包括：Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS。 使用上述接口，开发者即可实现与 DeepSeek App 基本一致的功能。为直观演示这一效果，DeepSeek 基于新版 API 构建并开源了一份轻量的前端 Demo，支持直接导入 DeepSeek 历史对话。 Demo 体验入口： https://cdn.deepseek.com/chat-demo 示例代码入口： https://github.com/deepseek-ai/chat-demo 据IT之家了解，用户调用 DeepSeek API 使用扩展能力时，除收取 Token 费用外，也将收取相关工具的调用费用。 文字 / 图片搜索：5 元 / 千次 网页抓取：5 元 / 千次 文字识别：1.5 元 / 千页 语音识别：限时 5 折，优惠后 0.39 元 / 小时 语音合成：限时 5 折，优惠后 1.5 元 / 万字符
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that DeepSeek announced this evening (the 13th) the official opening of its full-suite app API: by enabling the corresponding parameters in the existing API, developers can obtain conversation features such as deep-thinking search and file input; voice and related underlying capabilities have also opened independent interfaces (including OCR, ASR, TTS, etc.), supporting standalone or combined calls. Developers can easily implement complex conversation features in their own apps, and even replicate the complete DeepSeek App 1:1. This update directly integrates the interactive features of the DeepSeek App into the existing API. After enabling the corresponding parameters, related tool calls and context stitching are automatically handled by the server. Currently, the V4.1-Flash model (deepseek-flash) supports the following capabilities under the Messages, Responses, and Chat Completions interfaces: web search: in non-thinking mode, after enabling the deepseek_web_search tool, the model can automatically initiate web or image searches based on the question and answer with citations; deep-thinking search: in thinking mode, after enabling the deepseek_web_search tool, the model can autonomously search the web and read links during multi-step reasoning; file input: supports uploading PDF, Office, images, and other formats, completing plain-text extraction or mixed text-image parsing, and then adding it to the conversation context for the model to answer; link reading: after enabling the deepseek_read_url tool, the model can automatically recognize links in user messages, fetch webpage content, and answer in context; model safety: after enabling the safety verification parameter, DeepSeek will provide basic risk control, review model input and output, and return a refusal marker when risks are detected. If you provide application services externally, you must enable this parameter and bear obligations such as content safety review, large-model registration, and AI labeling. In addition, to make it easier for developers to connect to their own workflows more flexibly, the above underlying capabilities and voice capabilities can all be called as independent interfaces, including Search, Fetch, OCR, ASR, and TTS. Using these interfaces, developers can implement functions basically consistent with the DeepSeek App. To demonstrate this visually, DeepSeek built and open-sourced a lightweight frontend Demo based on the new API, supporting direct import of DeepSeek historical conversations. Demo experience entry: https://cdn.deepseek.com/chat-demo; sample code entry: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/chat-demo. According to IT之家, when users call DeepSeek API to use extended capabilities, in addition to token fees, tool call fees will also be charged. Text/image search: 5 yuan per thousand calls; web crawling: 5 yuan per thousand calls; OCR: 1.5 yuan per thousand pages; ASR: limited-time 50% off, 0.39 yuan per hour after discount; TTS: limited-time 50% off, 1.5 yuan per 10,000 characters.
items.why_zh: 推测：把 App 级对话能力与底层接口开放，可能降低开发者构建类 DeepSeek 应用的门槛，并扩大其模型与工具调用生态。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，今天（13 日）晚间，DeepSeek 宣布正式开放全家桶应用 API：在原有 API 中开启对应参数， 即可获得深度思考搜索、文件输入等对话功能 ；语音及相关底层能力也已开放独立接口（含 OCR、ASR、TTS 等），支持单独或组合调用。 开发者可以在自己的应用中轻松实现复杂的对话功能， 甚至 1:1 复刻出完整的 DeepSeek App 。 本次更新将 DeepSeek App 的各项交互功能直接整合进原有 API。开启对应参数后，相关工具调用与上下文拼接均由服务端自动完成。 目前，V4.1-Flash 模型（deepseek-flash）已在 Messages、Responses 与 Chat Completions 接口下支持以下能力： 联网搜索： 在非思考模式下，打开 deepseek_web_search 工具后，模型可根据提问自动发起网页或图片搜索并附引用作答； 深度思考搜索： 在思考模式下，打开 deepseek_web_search 工具后，模型可在多步推理中自主联网搜索与阅读链接； 文件输入： 支持上传 PDF、Office、图片等格式的文件，完成纯文本提取或图文混排解析后，拼入对话上下文供模型作答； 阅读链接： 将 deepseek_read_url 工具打开后，模型可自动识别用户消息中的链接，抓取网页内容并结合上下文作答； 模型安全： 开启安全校验参数后，DeepSeek 将提供基础风控，审核模型输入输出，命中风险时返回拒答标识。如您对外提供应用服务，请务必开启该参数，并承担内容安全审核、大模型登记、AI 标识等义务。 此外，为方便开发者更灵活地接入自有工作流，上述底层能力及语音能力 均支持作为独立接口单独调用 ，包括：Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS。 使用上述接口，开发者即可实现与 DeepSeek App 基本一致的功能。为直观演示这一效果，DeepSeek 基于新版 API 构建并开源了一份轻量的前端 Demo，支持直接导入 DeepSeek 历史对话。 Demo 体验入口： https://cdn.deepseek.com/chat-demo 示例代码入口： https://github.com/deepseek-ai/chat-demo 据IT之家了解，用户调用 DeepSeek API 使用扩展能力时，除收取 Token 费用外，也将收取相关工具的调用费用。 文字 / 图片搜索：5 元 / 千次 网页抓取：5 元 / 千次 文字识别：1.5 元 / 千页 语音识别：限时 5 折，优惠后 0.39 元 / 小时 语音合成：限时 5 折，优惠后 1.5 元 / 万字符

items.title_zh: AI 助力复活尘封 15 年废案，iOS 4 时代苹果卡片后台界面曝光
items.title_en: AI helps revive a 15-year-old scrapped project, exposing Apple’s card-based multitasking UI from the iOS 4 era
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据外媒 AppleInsider 今天（13 日）晚间报道，借助 AI 和模拟器技术，一套 尘封超过 15 年、从未正式发布的 iPhone 多任务切换界面 重新跑了起来。 2010 年初，该媒体曾报道苹果测试一套类似 Exposé 窗口总览功能的界面的消息。2011 年，有人在一台 iPhone 4 原型机上发现了搭载这套界面的特殊版本 iOS 4。 此后十多年，这套卡片式多任务界面始终无人公开演示，直到一名模拟器开发者借助 AI，让被苹果放弃的设计重见天日。 开发者史蒂夫 · 特劳顿-史密斯在 Mastodon 上分享了一段视频，展示这套从未发布的界面。视频中的 iOS 4 运行在 QEMU 模拟器的一个分支版本上，系统版本号为此前未曾公开的 8A218，比 2011 年发现的 8A216 版本略晚。 开发者向 AppleInsider 介绍说：“借助 AI 辅助开发的模拟器，现在 任何能找到的旧版 iOS 都可以运行起来。” 从现有信息判断，这个罕见的 iOS 版本 预计是提取自一台原型机 ，而不是苹果内部的系统恢复包。有人从开发设备或 iPhone 原型机中提取了根文件系统， 再借助 ChatGPT ，让系统成功在 QEMU 模拟器中启动。 视频展示了苹果开发 iOS 4 时尝试的 Exposé 式多任务界面。所有打开的应用 都以卡片形式排列在屏幕上 ，呈现出九宫格式布局。用户连按两次 Home 键，就能直接选择想要切换的应用，无需滚动浏览。 IT之家注：在如今常见的卡片式应用切换界面问世前，iPhone 曾采用从屏幕底部滑出的抽屉式菜单切换应用。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that, according to foreign media AppleInsider this evening (the 13th), with the help of AI and emulator technology, a set of iPhone multitasking switcher interfaces that had been buried for more than 15 years and never officially released was running again. In early 2010, the outlet reported that Apple was testing an interface similar to the Exposé window overview feature. In 2011, someone found a special version of iOS 4 carrying this interface on an iPhone 4 prototype. For more than a decade afterward, this card-based multitasking interface was never publicly demonstrated, until an emulator developer used AI to bring the abandoned Apple design back to light. Developer Steve Troughton-Smith shared a video on Mastodon showing this never-released interface. The iOS 4 in the video runs on a fork of the QEMU emulator, with a system build number of 8A218, which had not been publicly disclosed before and is slightly later than the 8A216 version found in 2011. The developer told AppleInsider: 'With the AI-assisted emulator, any old version of iOS you can find can now run.' Judging from the available information, this rare iOS version is expected to have been extracted from a prototype, rather than an Apple internal system restore image. Someone extracted the root filesystem from a development device or iPhone prototype and, with the help of ChatGPT, got the system to boot successfully in the QEMU emulator. The video shows the Exposé-style multitasking interface Apple tried while developing iOS 4. All open apps are arranged as cards on the screen in a nine-grid layout. Users can double-press the Home button to directly select the app they want to switch to, without scrolling. IT之家 note: before today’s common card-based app switcher emerged, the iPhone used a drawer-style menu sliding out from the bottom of the screen to switch apps.
items.why_zh: 推测：这表明 AI 辅助工具可降低旧系统与废弃设计的复原门槛，为软件史和逆向研究提供新手段。
items.why_en: Speculative: this suggests AI-assisted tools could lower the barrier to restoring old systems and abandoned designs, offering new means for software history and reverse-engineering research.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 连发多条故障通报：微软服务中断波及 Claude
items.title_en: Anthropic issues multiple outage notices: Microsoft service disruption affects Claude
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，微软 Microsoft 365 遭遇了近年来最严重的服务故障之一，Exchange Online、Outlook、SharePoint 及部分 Teams 服务中断近一天半。今天早些时候，微软一名高管为此次故障致歉，并对事态表示遗憾，基本承认短时间内无法解决问题。 Anthropic 将自身部分服务的故障归咎于 Microsoft 365 连接，并通过 Claude Status 页面陆续发布了以下通报： 调查中： 我们正在调查 Microsoft 365 连接器错误率升高、响应缓慢的问题。用户通过连接器访问邮件、SharePoint、Teams 聊天和日历时可能遇到请求失败，新用户也可能无法完成连接。我们会尽快通报调查进展。 已查明： 问题出在上游服务提供商，导致 Microsoft 365 连接器受到影响。邮件、日历和搜索功能的大多数请求均无法正常处理，新建连接也可能失败。我们正与服务提供商沟通，并将尽快通报进展。 更新： 我们仍在与上游服务提供商合作处理故障。Microsoft 365 连接器的邮件、日历和搜索功能大部分请求仍无法正常处理。Claude for Outlook 也受到波及，用户可能无法执行邮件和日历操作，部分用户甚至无法打开加载项。我们将在一小时内再次更新。 …… 更新： 故障源于 Microsoft 365 服务异常，连接器的邮件、日历和搜索功能仍无法正常处理大多数请求，Claude for Outlook 也尚未恢复。 然而，Claude 遭遇了新的服务故障。据IT之家今天早些时候报道，Anthropic 确认， claude.ai 、Claude Code 和 platform.claude.com 均出现错误率异常升高的情况，用户无法在这些平台完成身份验证。 相关阅读： 《 Claude 出现大量报错，Anthropic 官方公告称正在调查 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that Microsoft 365 suffered one of its most serious service outages in recent years, with Exchange Online, Outlook, SharePoint, and some Teams services interrupted for nearly a day and a half. Earlier today, a Microsoft executive apologized for the outage and expressed regret over the situation, essentially acknowledging that it could not be resolved in a short time. Anthropic attributed some of its own service failures to Microsoft 365 connections and issued the following updates via the Claude Status page: Investigating: We are investigating elevated error rates and slow responses for the Microsoft 365 connector. Users may encounter failed requests when accessing mail, SharePoint, Teams chats, and calendars through the connector, and new users may also be unable to complete connections. We will provide updates as soon as possible. Identified: The problem lies with an upstream service provider, affecting the Microsoft 365 connector. Most requests for mail, calendar, and search functions cannot be processed normally, and new connections may also fail. We are communicating with the service provider and will provide updates as soon as possible. Update: We are still working with the upstream service provider to address the failure. Most requests for mail, calendar, and search functions of the Microsoft 365 connector still cannot be processed normally. Claude for Outlook is also affected; users may be unable to perform email and calendar operations, and some users may even be unable to open the add-in. We will update again within an hour. ... Update: The failure stems from an abnormality in the Microsoft 365 service; the connector’s mail, calendar, and search functions still cannot process most requests normally, and Claude for Outlook has not yet recovered. However, Claude suffered a new service failure. According to an IT之家 report earlier today, Anthropic confirmed that claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com all saw abnormally elevated error rates, and users were unable to complete authentication on these platforms. Related reading: 'Claude shows many errors; Anthropic official announcement says it is investigating.'
items.why_zh: 推测：该事件显示 AI 助手与办公套件深度集成后，上游服务故障会传导至 AI 服务，凸显依赖链与状态透明度的重要性。
items.why_en: Speculative: this incident shows that after AI assistants are deeply integrated with office suites, upstream service failures can propagate to AI services, highlighting the importance of dependency chains and status transparency.

items.title_zh: 开源欧拉 openEuler 发布面向 Agentic Infra 的操作系统，国内累计装机量预计超 2200 万套
items.title_en: Open-source openEuler releases an operating system for Agentic Infra; cumulative domestic installations expected to top 22 million
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，在今日举行的 Agentic Infra 操作系统大会 & openEuler Summit 2026 上，开源欧拉 openEuler 正式发布面向 Agentic Infra（IT之家注：Agentic Infrastructure， 智能体基础设施 ）的操作系统。 据介绍，openEuler 升级为面向 Agentic Infra 的操作系统，提供沙箱、KV Cache、记忆系统与 Agent 安全等关键能力，支持 AI 推理、Agent 应用等场景，已经在互联网，金融等行业头部用户商用落地。 开放原子开源基金会理事长谢少锋现场披露， openEuler 系操作系统国内累计装机量预计突破 2200 万套 。会上，开放原子开源欧拉委员会主席熊伟发布了 openEuler 24.03 LTS SP5 版本。 此外，openEuler 社区计划到年底实现 80% CVE 由 AI 辅助处理，社区服务 Agent 100% 接入。在全球化层面，巴基斯坦高等教育委员会正式发布 HECOS 1.0，成为 海外首个基于 openEuler 的本土操作系统 。 延伸阅读 所谓 Agentic Infra，指的是支撑 AI 智能体（Agent）构建、运行、连接、监控与管理的技术底座。它通常涵盖模型推理资源、Agent 运行时、编排调度、工具调用、数据接入、任务状态管理、记忆系统、身份权限控制以及监控等组件，可根据不同系统设计支持多步骤工作流、工具集成与外部系统交互。 openEuler 起源于华为自研的服务器操作系统 EulerOS，于 2019 年 9 月正式开源。2021 年 9 月，华为宣布将其从服务器操作系统升级为数字基础设施的操作系统；同年 11 月，华为携手社区伙伴将 openEuler 捐赠给开放原子开源基金会，其发展模式由企业主导转向产业共建、社区自治。 在装机量方面，openEuler 曾于 2024 年 11 月披露，开源五年累计装机量突破 1000 万套，其中 2024 年新增装机量超过 500 万套。此次预计突破 2200 万套，意味着其规模在约两年间实现翻倍以上增长。 在社区规模上，目前 openEuler 社区拥有超过 2200 家成员单位、超过 3 万名开源贡献者，覆盖金融、电信、能源等关键行业，并已进入卫星系统、具身智能等新兴领域。 在本次大会之前，openEuler 已于 2026 年 10 月 1 日发布 26.09 创新版本，推出 6.6 与 6.18 双内核，AI 场景新增 Agent 可观测、SkillHub、上下文管理、KV Cache 协同加速、模型加载优化等特性，并完成面向 Agentic AI 的技术升级。 在全球化协作方面，openEuler 还将与全球头部操作系统厂商 Ubuntu 在超节点等技术领域开展协作交流；大会现场宣布了社区新增白金捐赠人，并揭晓了 20 个“2026 年度 openEuler 领先商业实践”项目案例。
items.summary_en: At the Agentic Infra Operating System Conference & openEuler Summit 2026, openEuler officially released an operating system for Agentic Infra (agent infrastructure), offering key capabilities such as sandboxing, KV Cache, a memory system and agent security, supporting AI inference and agent applications, and already commercially deployed with leading users in internet and financial industries. Xie Shaofeng, chairman of the OpenAtom Foundation, disclosed that cumulative domestic installations of openEuler-based operating systems are expected to exceed 22 million. Xiong Wei, chairman of the OpenAtom openEuler Committee, released openEuler 24.03 LTS SP5. The community plans by year-end to have 80% of CVEs handled with AI assistance and 100% of community service agents connected. On globalization, Pakistan's Higher Education Commission released HECOS 1.0, the first overseas local operating system based on openEuler. openEuler originated from Huawei's EulerOS, was open-sourced in September 2019 and donated to the OpenAtom Foundation in November 2021; in November 2024 it disclosed cumulative installations of over 10 million in its first five open-source years. The community now has more than 2,200 member organizations and over 30,000 contributors.
items.why_zh: 推测：若 2200 万套装机量预期成立，说明 openEuler 在智能体基础设施层的布局已具备规模化基础，但该数字为会上披露的预计值，尚待后续核实。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，在今日举行的 Agentic Infra 操作系统大会 & openEuler Summit 2026 上，开源欧拉 openEuler 正式发布面向 Agentic Infra（IT之家注：Agentic Infrastructure， 智能体基础设施 ）的操作系统。 据介绍，openEuler 升级为面向 Agentic Infra 的操作系统，提供沙箱、KV Cache、记忆系统与 Agent 安全等关键能力，支持 AI 推理、Agent 应用等场景，已经在互联网，金融等行业头部用户商用落地。 开放原子开源基金会理事长谢少锋现场披露， openEuler 系操作系统国内累计装机量预计突破 2200 万套 。会上，开放原子开源欧拉委员会主席熊伟发布了 openEuler 24.03 LTS SP5 版本。 此外，openEuler 社区计划到年底实现 80% CVE 由 AI 辅助处理，社区服务 Agent 100% 接入。在全球化层面，巴基斯坦高等教育委员会正式发布 HECOS 1.0，成为 海外首个基于 openEuler 的本土操作系统 。 延伸阅读 所谓 Agentic Infra，指的是支撑 AI 智能体（Agent）构建、运行、连接、监控与管理的技术底座。它通常涵盖模型推理资源、Agent 运行时、编排调度、工具调用、数据接入、任务状态管理、记忆系统、身份权限控制以及监控等组件，可根据不同系统设计支持多步骤工作流、工具集成与外部系统交互。 openEuler 起源于华为自研的服务器操作系统 EulerOS，于 2019 年 9 月正式开源。2021 年 9 月，华为宣布将其从服务器操作系统升级为数字基础设施的操作系统；同年 11 月，华为携手社区伙伴将 openEuler 捐赠给开放原子开源基金会，其发展模式由企业主导转向产业共建、社区自治。 在装机量方面，openEuler 曾于 2024 年 11 月披露，开源五年累计装机量突破 1000 万套，其中 2024 年新增装机量超过 500 万套。此次预计突破 2200 万套，意味着其规模在约两年间实现翻倍以上增长。 在社区规模上，目前 openEuler 社区拥有超过 2200 家成员单位、超过 3 万名开源贡献者，覆盖金融、电信、能源等关键行业，并已进入卫星系统、具身智能等新兴领域。 在本次大会之前，openEuler 已于 2026 年 10 月 1 日发布 26.09 创新版本，推出 6.6 与 6.18 双内核，AI 场景新增 Agent 可观测、SkillHub、上下文管理、KV Cache 协同加速、模型加载优化等特性，并完成面向 Agentic AI 的技术升级。 在全球化协作方面，openEuler 还将与全球头部操作系统厂商 Ubuntu 在超节点等技术领域开展协作交流；大会现场宣布了社区新增白金捐赠人，并揭晓了 20 个“2026 年度 openEuler 领先商业实践”项目案例。

items.title_en: Report: SpaceXAI shifts resources to AI coding tools and Grok Bot, cutting about 60 Grok Imagine staff
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据 The Information 引述知情人士消息，SpaceXAI 已对旗下视频与图像生成 AI 工具 Grok Imagine 的大部分研发人员进行了裁撤。 本次裁员涉及约 60 名 Grok Imagine 团队成员 ，目前仅保留少数人员以维持产品的基础运营。尽管该工具现阶段仍可正常访问与使用，但在失去专职研发团队支撑后，其后续发展前景已变得不明朗。 自 2026 年 2 月 xAI 与 SpaceX 完成合并以来，该公司内部便持续推进架构重组，此次人员缩减正是这一调整进程的延续。 知情人士透露，在今年 2 月以价值 2,500 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.67 万亿元人民币） 的股票收购马斯克旗下人工智能公司 xAI 后，SpaceX 已将战略重心倾斜至 AI 编程工具和 Grok Bot 智能体产品，其优先级高于其他业务线。而 8 月份 SpaceX 以 600 亿美元 （现汇率约合 4,011.04 亿元人民币） 收购 AI 编程初创企业 Cursor，便是这一战略转型的具体举措之一。
items.summary_en: Citing people familiar with the matter, The Information reported that SpaceXAI has laid off most of the R&D staff behind its video and image generation tool Grok Imagine, affecting about 60 team members, with only a few retained to keep basic operations running. The tool remains accessible and usable for now, but its prospects are unclear without a dedicated development team. Since xAI and SpaceX completed their merger in February 2026, the company has continued internal restructuring, and this reduction is a continuation of that process. The sources said that after acquiring xAI in February for $250 billion in stock, SpaceX has shifted its strategic focus toward AI coding tools and the Grok Bot agent product, giving them higher priority than other business lines; its $60 billion August acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor is one concrete step in that shift.
items.why_zh: 推测：若消息属实，显示合并后的 SpaceXAI 正把资源集中到编程与智能体产品线，视频生成团队被边缘化；该信息来自二手报道，尚未见公司官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculation: if accurate, the report suggests post-merger SpaceXAI is concentrating resources on coding and agent products while sidelining its video generation team; the information comes from second-hand reporting and has not been officially confirmed by the company.

items.title_zh: 韩国拟采购无线电探测设备，防范国家资格考试“AI 作弊”
items.title_en: South Korea plans to buy radio-signal detectors to curb AI cheating in national qualification exams
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据新华社报道，由于担心考生利用 AI 眼镜等高科技设备在国家资格考试中作弊，韩国正考虑采取应对措施。 韩国最大在野党国民力量党议员金渭相近日提议，在 2027 年度预算中增加约 65.7 亿韩元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 3,286.3 万元人民币） 经费，用于 采购无线电信号探测设备 并安排专职人员，防范国家资格考试中的 AI 作弊行为。 韩国国会此前已关注到高科技作弊问题。负责组织国家资格考试的韩国产业人力公团随后估算了所需经费，提出 花费 36 亿韩元 （现汇率约合 1,800.7 万元人民币） 采购 7200 台无线电信号探测设备 ，投入 29.7 亿韩元 （现汇率约合 1,485.6 万元人民币） 安排 23559 名负责识别高科技作弊的专职人员。有关预算增拨方案尚需经过国会审议。 韩国产业人力公团表示，AI 眼镜外观与普通眼镜相似，监考人员通过肉眼识别难度大， 引入无线电信号探测设备有助于提高监考实效 。数据显示，截至 10 月底，韩国今年举行的国家资格考试中已查获 6 起涉及智能眼镜的作弊案件。 韩国将于 19 日举行大学修学能力考试（即高考）。今年 7 月，韩国教育部已将 AI 眼镜列入考场禁带物品清单。为防范相关作弊行为，韩国教育部门近期对监考人员开展专项培训，全国 1312 个考点均将配备 至少 1 名专门负责识别 AI 眼镜的监考人员 。由于尚无专用探测设备，今年高考主要依靠 目视 检查。 韩国教育部警告，在高考中使用 AI 眼镜作弊的考生，可能面临 多至 3 年禁考处罚 ，并被追究刑事责任。
items.summary_en: According to Xinhua, South Korea is considering countermeasures over concerns that test-takers may use high-tech devices such as AI glasses to cheat in national qualification exams. Kim Wi-sang, a lawmaker of the main opposition People Power Party, proposed adding about 6.57 billion won to the 2027 budget to buy radio-signal detection equipment and staff dedicated personnel. The Human Resources Development Service of Korea, which organizes the national qualification exams, estimated that 3.6 billion won would buy 7,200 radio-signal detectors and 2.97 billion won would fund 23,559 dedicated staff to identify high-tech cheating; the supplementary budget plan still requires parliamentary review. The service said AI glasses resemble ordinary glasses and are hard for proctors to spot by eye, so detectors would improve exam supervision. As of the end of October, six cheating cases involving smart glasses had been caught in this year's national qualification exams. South Korea holds its college scholastic ability test on the 19th; in July the education ministry added AI glasses to the list of banned items, and all 1,312 test sites will have at least one proctor dedicated to spotting AI glasses. With no dedicated detectors available, this year's test will rely mainly on visual inspection. The ministry warned that cheating with AI glasses could lead to a ban of up to three years and criminal liability.
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映 AI 眼镜普及正在给考场监管带来现实压力，也显示监管手段目前仍落后于设备形态。
items.why_en: Speculation: this reflects how the spread of AI glasses is creating real pressure on exam supervision, and shows that enforcement tools currently lag behind the devices themselves.

items.title_zh: Gentle Monster / Warby Parker 将于下月推出 Android XR 智能眼镜：均搭载高通 AR1 芯片，接入谷歌 Gemini
items.title_en: Gentle Monster and Warby Parker to launch Android XR smart glasses next month, both with Qualcomm AR1 chips and Google Gemini
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，知名眼镜品牌 Gentle Monster 和 Warby Parker 各自宣布将于下月推出首款基于 Android XR 平台打造的智能眼镜，产品由三星与谷歌联合参与开发。目前，两大品牌的相关产品均已开启预订，预计将于 12 月 10 日正式在线上及指定线下门店发售。 据介绍，Gentle Monster 和 Warby Parker 的新品均搭载高通 Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 芯片，均配备一颗 1,200 万像素摄像头，除了能够拍摄照片 / 视频外，还能借助 AI 实现实时翻译、逐向导航、接打电话和播放音乐等功能。不过，两款产品并未采用 Meta AI，而是接入谷歌 Gemini，用户可以通过眼镜与 Gemini 交互，并使用多项谷歌服务。 Gentle Monster 智能眼镜 起售价：449 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 3,002 元人民币） 相应眼镜共推出 6 款设计，部分款式可选深红色、粉色、灰色和黄色镜框，镜片则提供染色、透明、蓝色和棕色等选项，大多数镜框还支持选配近视等处方镜片。 Warby Parker 智能眼镜 起售价：395 美元 （现汇率约合 2,641 元人民币） 相应眼镜共推出 Alden、Reid 和 Wren 三种款式，设计灵感号称来自 Warby Parker 品牌旗下多款热门眼镜。用户可以选择 Pine、Saddle 和 Jet Black 三种配色，并根据需求选择不同的处方镜片、镜框宽度及镜片配置。
items.summary_en: Gentle Monster and Warby Parker each announced they will launch their first smart glasses based on the Android XR platform next month, developed with the joint participation of Samsung and Google. Both products are already available for pre-order and are expected to go on sale online and at select physical stores on December 10. Both use the Qualcomm Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 chip and a 12-megapixel camera, and beyond photos and video they support AI-based real-time translation, turn-by-turn navigation, calls and music playback; rather than Meta AI, they connect to Google Gemini, letting users interact with Gemini and use multiple Google services. Gentle Monster's glasses start at $449, come in six designs, with some frames offered in dark red, pink, grey and yellow and lenses in tinted, clear, blue and brown options, and most frames support prescription lenses. Warby Parker's glasses start at $395, come in Alden, Reid and Wren styles inspired by popular Warby Parker frames, with Pine, Saddle and Jet Black colorways and choices of prescription lenses, frame widths and lens configurations.

items.title_zh: BBC 曝光英国“房源照骗”现象：有中介、卖家开始用 AI 伪造或美化房屋
items.title_en: BBC exposes UK 'housefishing': some agents and sellers use AI to fake or embellish property photos
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，房源照片是网上售房信息中最重要的内容之一。买家通常会先看照片，再判断房屋是否符合自己的需求和购房预期。 但随着 AI 技术的发展， 一种新型网络骗局让看房买房变得更加麻烦 。 据英国广播公司（BBC）今天上午报道，利用 AI 伪造或美化房源照片的“房源照骗（IT之家注：housefishing，直译作‘房屋钓鱼’）”现象越来越普遍。一些房产中介和卖家 通过 AI 大幅修改照片，甚至直接生成虚假图片 ，让房屋显得更加漂亮、宽敞或现代化。 BBC 报道了一名女子的遭遇。奥利维娅 · 妮可在网上寻找伦敦西南部的五居室房源时，看中了房地产平台 Rightmove 上的一套房子。然而，等她亲自上门看房时，却以为自己找错了地方。 奥利维娅 · 妮可告诉 BBC：“ 房间比照片里小得多，装修完全不一样 ，连部分建筑结构都有区别。”她发现，沙发后面的墙面有一处凸起，照片里却看不到，窗户也明显比照片中小。眼前的房子与照片相差太大，她索性拍下实景照片进行对比。 原来，Rightmove 上的房源照片经过 AI 美化。奥利维娅 · 妮可感觉自己受了骗，认为房产中介浪费了她的时间，毕竟她专门从工作中抽出几个小时来看房。 BBC 指出：“房产中介长期以来都会 使用广角镜头或 Photoshop ，让房屋看起来更宽敞、更有吸引力， 而 AI 让这些操作变得更加简单，也更容易实现 。” 英国网络名人、社交媒体系列节目《Housing Horrors》主持人杰克 · 布什罗德发现， 过去六个月，经过 AI 美化的房源照片明显增多 ，而且大多数没有明确标注使用了 AI 生成技术。 布什罗德并不反对合理使用 AI，认为可以用来清除照片中杂乱的物品，或者给空房间添加家具，让潜在买家了解房屋的布置空间。但他反对利用 AI 误导买家，浪费他们的看房时间。 他举例说：“我见过一套房子，照片里不仅 去掉了一根柱子，还多出了一扇窗户 。有些人会用 AI 抹掉地毯上的污渍，或者修掉瓷砖上的裂缝。这些细节很小，只有到现场才能发现。” 布什罗德预计，“房源照骗”今后会越来越普遍。“我担心，随着更多房产中介开始使用 AI，其他中介也会看到这种趋势，纷纷跟风。” 面对越来越普遍的 AI 修图现象，一家房产中介机构的女发言人向 BBC 透露，公司出台了新规定， 所有经过 AI 美化的房源照片都必须明确标注 。“我们希望帮助人们想象房屋还能变成什么样，而不是改变正在出售的房屋的真实面貌。”
items.summary_en: The BBC reported that 'housefishing' — using AI to fake or enhance property listing photos — is increasingly common in the UK, with some estate agents and sellers heavily editing photos or outright generating fake images to make homes look prettier, larger or more modern. A woman, Olivia Nichol, found a five-bedroom listing in south-west London on Rightmove, but on visiting thought she had gone to the wrong place: rooms were much smaller than in the photos, the decor was completely different and parts of the structure differed, with a bulge in the wall behind the sofa not visible in the photos and windows clearly smaller. She photographed the reality for comparison and felt deceived, saying the agent had wasted her time. The BBC noted that agents have long used wide-angle lenses or Photoshop to make homes look bigger, and AI makes this easier. Jack Bushrod, host of the social media series Housing Horrors, found AI-enhanced listing photos had clearly increased over the past six months, mostly without any label saying AI was used. He does not oppose reasonable AI use, such as removing clutter or adding furniture to empty rooms, but objects to misleading buyers, citing photos where a pillar was removed, an extra window added, carpet stains erased or tile cracks repaired. He expects housefishing to become more common. A spokesperson for one estate agency told the BBC that the company has introduced a rule requiring all AI-enhanced listing photos to be clearly labeled.
items.why_zh: 推测：AI 修图门槛降低可能加剧线上房源信息失真，进而影响买家决策效率与中介的信息披露规范。
items.why_en: Speculation: lower barriers to AI photo editing may worsen distortion in online listings, affecting buyers' decision-making and pushing agencies toward clearer disclosure rules.

items.title_en: More game developers are starting to use generative AI
items.summary_zh: 根据 GDC Festival of Gaming 最新的年度行业调查，与去年相比，更多电子游戏开发者会在工作中使用生成式 AI 工具。40% 的受访开发者表示他们“将其作为工作的一部分”使用，高于 2025 年的 36%。使用率在从事免费游玩（free-to-play）游戏的开发者中更高，为 58%；在仅做移动端的工作室员工中为 70%。该调查发布之际，游戏行业仍在持续审视生成式 AI 工具：许多开发者（尤其独立开发者）已公开强烈反对该技术，而 AI 也处于独立游戏奖项争议的中心。（全文请见 The Verge）
items.summary_en: A photo from the GDC Festival of Gaming 2026 event. More video game developers are using generative AI tools in their jobs compared to last year, according to the GDC Festival of Gaming's latest annual industry survey . Forty percent of developers surveyed say they use it "as part of their job," an increase from 36 percent in 2025 . Usage was higher with game developers that work on free-to-play games at 58 percent and mobile-only studio workers at 70 percent. The survey is being published as the game industry continues to reckon with generative AI tools. items.why_zh: 调查数据显示生成式 AI 在游戏开发中的使用比例上升，可能进一步激化行业关于岗位、创作方式与伦理的争论；调查方法的代表性尚不清楚（推测）。
items.why_en: The survey data show a rising share of generative AI use in game development, which may further intensify industry debate over jobs, creative practice and ethics; the survey's representativeness is unclear (speculative).

items.title_zh: 亚马逊秘密构想曝光：欲打造“世界商品图谱”，包揽全网商品数据
items.title_en: Amazon secret plan reportedly revealed: aiming to build a 'World Product Graph' covering product data across the web
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据路透社报道，亚马逊有一项秘密计划，旨在让消费者从此无需离开其平台，拥有世界上的商品信息。 据该媒体审阅的一份内部文件及知情人士透露，这项名为“世界商品图谱”（World Product Graph）的计划， 试图将全球几乎所有在售商品的数据悉数收入囊中 —— 无论亚马逊是否备有这些商品的库存。 借此，亚马逊可以真正成为“万货商店”，不仅能提供海量商品的深度数据、切入谷歌在在线搜索领域的腹地，还能有效抵御竞争对手沃尔玛不断扩张的电商业务。 这一举措也是为了应对 AI 购物智能体的持续崛起。该内部文件指出，亚马逊自家的 AI 搜索智能体目前经常提供不准确的信息。一旦“世界商品图谱”全面落地，凭借庞大的数据体量，亚马逊将把消费者从数据匮乏的竞争对手电商平台吸引过来。 不过，亚马逊回应称：“该内部文件使用的数据已严重过时。”亚马逊表示，其内部数据显示，Alexa for Shopping 在全球范围内的准确率约为 97%。 内部文件还写道：“如果消费者不得不离开亚马逊，去谷歌、品牌官网和评测网站上费力研究商品之间的关联，亚马逊就无法成为用户每次购物的首选目的地。这些答案本身是存在的，但过去用户只能离开亚马逊，到品牌官网、第三方评测网站和科技论坛里苦苦搜寻。” 目前尚无法确定该计划是否以及何时落地，不过这份行文风格宛如新闻稿的文件，将目标发布日期设定在了 2027 年 10 月 1 日。 亚马逊在一份声明中回应称：“ 草稿和过时的文件往往只能反映片面的情况 ，这类头脑风暴文件的存在并不一定代表我们当前的计划。我们一直在探索新想法和新技术，致力于让亚马逊的商品目录更加全面、准确，为消费者提供切实帮助。” 该文件指出，“世界商品图谱”的核心在于摸清各大品牌是如何在自家官网上归类与展示商品的。这既需要部分品牌方和零售商持续向亚马逊提供商品数据，也意味着亚马逊将自行爬取其他零售商的网站。尚无法确定亚马逊计划如何爬取这些网站，以及它在所有情况下是否都需要征得对方许可。 文件显示，亚马逊目前已与可口可乐和拜耳等公司签约，由对方提供商品数据；同时，亚马逊还与宝洁举行了“CEO 级别的宝洁 / 亚马逊峰会”，就相关试点展开探讨。上述公司均未回应置评请求。 IT之家注：阐述该计划的文件在亚马逊内部被称为 PR / FAQ（即新闻稿与常见问题解答）—— 这通常是一份六页的叙述性备忘录，用于论证新产品或新服务的底层逻辑与商业价值。知情人士表示， 并非所有 PR / FAQ 最终都会转化为实际产品 ；出于财务或其他方面的考量，“世界商品图谱”仍有可能被修改甚至叫停。
items.summary_en: Reuters reports that Amazon has a secret plan aimed at letting consumers obtain global product information without leaving its platform. According to an internal document reviewed by the outlet and people familiar with the matter, the plan, called 'World Product Graph,' seeks to capture data on nearly all products on sale worldwide, whether or not Amazon stocks them. This could help Amazon become a true 'everything store,' offer deep data on a vast range of products, encroach on Google's online search territory and defend against Walmart's expanding e-commerce business; the move is also aimed at responding to the rise of AI shopping agents. The internal document says Amazon's own AI search agent often provides inaccurate information; once the plan is fully implemented, Amazon could use its vast data scale to attract consumers from data-poor rival platforms. Amazon responded that the data used in the internal document is severely outdated and said its internal data shows Alexa for Shopping has about 97% accuracy globally. The document also says that if consumers have to leave Amazon to research product relationships on Google, brand websites and review sites, Amazon cannot become the preferred destination for every shopping occasion. It is not yet certain whether or when the plan will be implemented, but the document, written in a style resembling a press release, sets a target launch date of October 1, 2027. Amazon said in a statement that drafts and outdated documents often reflect only a partial picture, and that the existence of such brainstorming documents does not necessarily represent its current plans; the company said it is always exploring new ideas and technologies to make its catalog more comprehensive and accurate and to genuinely help consumers. The document says the core of 'World Product Graph' is to understand how major brands categorize and display products on their own websites. This requires some brands and retailers to continuously provide product data to Amazon and also means Amazon will crawl other retailers' websites itself; it is not yet certain how Amazon plans to crawl these sites or whether it needs permission in all cases. The document shows Amazon has signed contracts with companies including Coca-Cola and Bayer to provide product data, and held a 'CEO-level P&G/Amazon summit' with P&G to discuss related pilots; the companies did not respond to requests for comment. The document describing the plan is called a PR/FAQ internally at Amazon, typically a narrative memo used to justify the underlying logic and business value of a new product or service. People familiar with the matter said not all PR/FAQs ultimately become actual products; 'World Product Graph' could still be modified or even stopped for financial or other reasons.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该计划推进，亚马逊可能强化对商品数据与AI购物入口的控制，但也将引发数据爬取许可、竞争与信息准确性争议。
items.why_en: Speculative: if the plan moves forward, Amazon could strengthen control over product data and AI shopping entry points, but it would also raise disputes over crawling permissions, competition and information accuracy.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，谷歌 DeepMind 今天正式开放 WeatherNext 3 气象模型所依托的两大基础数据集 SatWeave 与 PARDIG，相应数据集面向全球研究者与开发者提供实时数据流及历史归档，可用于天气、水文、气候及相关下游应用建模。 据介绍，SatWeave 是一套整合多颗静止气象卫星的全球影像拼接产品，聚合了 GOES-East、GOES-West、Meteosat 0、Meteosat 印度洋星以及 Himawari 共 5 颗卫星的观测数据，解决了不同卫星在地图投影、文件格式、传感器与扫描节奏上的差异难题。该数据集每小时更新一次，并提供跨越十年以上的历史存档，能够让 WeatherNext 3 基于实时云图与风暴动态生成逐小时全球预报，而传统分析数据通常每六小时才刷新一次。谷歌还希望研究社区将其拓展至太阳能功率预测、野火监测等场景。 而 PARDIG 是一套基于 AI 架构的全球降水再分析数据集，采用与 WeatherNext 3 相似的球形图网格 Transformer 架构，直接以 NASA 全球降水测量核心观测台的稀疏星载雷达观测为训练目标，输入使用 SatWeave 影像与欧洲中期天气预报中心的大气场。其空间分辨率约 10 公里（0.1°），时间分辨率 15 分钟，平均延迟约 5 小时。 谷歌通过对照美国、欧洲、日本三大陆基雷达网络及全球 3.6 万余座气象站的评估显示，PARDIG 在所有雨强档位上均优于 NASA IMERG-Final 等主流基线产品；对轻到中度降水的小时级识别技巧较 IMERG-Final 提升 30% 以上，对极端降水的捕捉能力尤为突出。由于模型直接从卫星观测学习，其在缺乏地面雷达与雨量计的地区同样具备可靠精度。 除此之外，谷歌本次还同步开放 1999 年至 2026 年的 PARDIG 历史档案以及 SatWeave 与 PARDIG 的实时数据流。相应数据托管在 Google Cloud Storage 上，以 CC BY 4.0 许可开放。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced the opening of SatWeave and PARDIG, the two foundational datasets underpinning the WeatherNext 3 weather model, providing real-time data streams and historical archives to researchers and developers worldwide for modeling weather, hydrology, climate and related downstream applications. SatWeave is a global imagery mosaic product integrating multiple geostationary weather satellites, combining observations from five satellites: GOES-East, GOES-West, Meteosat 0, Meteosat Indian Ocean and Himawari, solving differences among satellites in map projection, file format, sensors and scanning cadence. The dataset updates hourly and provides historical archives spanning more than a decade, enabling WeatherNext 3 to generate hourly global forecasts based on real-time cloud imagery and storm dynamics, whereas traditional analysis data usually refreshes only every six hours. Google also hopes the research community will extend it to scenarios such as solar power forecasting and wildfire monitoring. PARDIG is a global precipitation reanalysis dataset based on an AI architecture, using a spherical graph-grid Transformer architecture similar to WeatherNext 3, directly trained on sparse spaceborne radar observations from NASA's Global Precipitation Measurement Core Observatory, with SatWeave imagery and ECMWF atmospheric fields as inputs. Its spatial resolution is about 10 km (0.1°), temporal resolution is 15 minutes, and average latency is about 5 hours. Google's evaluation against the three major land-based radar networks in the United States, Europe and Japan and more than 36,000 weather stations worldwide shows that PARDIG outperforms mainstream baseline products such as NASA IMERG-Final across all rain-rate levels; its hourly detection skill for light to moderate precipitation is more than 30% higher than IMERG-Final, and its ability to capture extreme precipitation is particularly notable. Because the model learns directly from satellite observations, it also has reliable accuracy in regions lacking ground radar and rain gauges. Google also opened the PARDIG historical archive from 1999 to 2026 and real-time data streams for SatWeave and PARDIG. The data is hosted on Google Cloud Storage and opened under the CC BY 4.0 license.
items.why_zh: 推测：开放高时空分辨率气象数据可能降低天气与气候建模门槛，并推动新能源、灾害监测等下游应用，但实际采用效果仍待观察。
items.why_en: Speculative: opening high spatiotemporal-resolution weather data could lower barriers to weather and climate modeling and promote downstream applications such as renewable energy and disaster monitoring, but actual adoption remains to be seen.

items.title_zh: 微软 XBOX 25 周年，CEO 夏尔马称个人将能掌握过去需“举国之力”获得的能力
items.title_en: Microsoft Xbox at 25: CEO Sharma says individuals will be able to master capabilities that once required 'a nation's effort'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，当地时间 12 日下午，微软 XBOX 负责人阿莎 · 夏尔马发布了一份备忘录， 暗示未来可能利用生成式 AI 辅助游戏开发 。 备忘录的标题为《XBOX 的 25 年》，回顾了微软从创立初期的小规模企业发展为拥有数千名员工的公司的历程。不过，真正值得关注的是夏尔马在结尾对未来的展望。 IT之家从备忘录内容获悉，谈及 XBOX 未来 25 年的发展时，夏尔马感叹， 太多游戏创意未能付诸实现 ，即使最终做成游戏，也有不少作品没能达到创作者的预期。“几十年来，想要实现宏大的目标，就只能接受这样的取舍。我们必须改变这种局面。” “纵观人类历史，创作规模始终受制于能够调动的人力、资金和资源。但这种限制开始被打破了。 过去需要举国之力才能实现的事情，很快一个人就能做到 。今天需要数百名开发者、耗资数亿美元打造的游戏世界，未来一个小团队就能完成。至于我们最大的工作室，也将有能力实现远超当今游戏的宏伟构想，就像《微软模拟飞行 2024》相较于 1982 年的系列初代作品，取得了跨越式的进步。” 外媒 Eurogamer 认为，夏尔马所说的个人将拥有过去需要举国之力才能实现的能力，很容易让人联想到生成式 AI。在接掌 XBOX 之前，夏尔马在微软此前也主要从事 AI 业务。 不过，自担任 CEO 后，夏尔马对生成式 AI 始终保持谨慎态度。当时，她曾明确称自己“无法容忍劣质 AI”。此后几个月，Xbox 又经历了包括大规模重组在内的诸多变化，生成式 AI 也逐渐不再是讨论焦点。 报道指出，这封备忘录暗示着夏尔马此前的 AI 计划开始初露端倪。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov. 13: On the afternoon of the 12th local time, Microsoft Xbox head Asha Sharma released a memo, hinting that generative AI may be used in the future to assist game development. The memo, titled '25 Years of Xbox,' reviewed Microsoft's journey from a small startup to a company with thousands of employees. What is really noteworthy is Sharma's outlook at the end. According to the memo, discussing Xbox's next 25 years, Sharma lamented that too many game ideas have never been realized, and even when games are made, many fail to meet creators' expectations. 'For decades, achieving grand goals meant accepting such trade-offs. We must change this.' 'Throughout human history, the scale of creation has always been constrained by the people, money and resources that can be mobilized. But that limitation is beginning to break. What once required the effort of an entire nation will soon be achievable by one person. Game worlds that today require hundreds of developers and hundreds of millions of dollars could be built by a small team in the future. As for our largest studios, they will also be able to realize grand visions far beyond today's games, just as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 has made a leap compared with the 1982 original.' Eurogamer believes Sharma's claim that individuals will have capabilities that once required a nation's effort easily brings generative AI to mind. Before taking over Xbox, Sharma mainly worked in AI-related business at Microsoft. However, since becoming CEO, Sharma has remained cautious about generative AI, explicitly saying she 'cannot tolerate low-quality AI.' In the months since, Xbox has undergone many changes, including large-scale restructuring, and generative AI has gradually ceased to be the focus of discussion. The report notes that the memo suggests Sharma's earlier AI plans are beginning to show signs.
items.why_zh: 若生成式 AI 真能大幅降低游戏创作的人力与资金门槛，可能改变游戏开发组织方式；但备忘录只是暗示，尚未公布具体工具或时间表（推测）。
items.why_en: If generative AI can substantially lower the manpower and funding barriers to game creation, it could change how games are developed; the memo only hints at this, with no specific tools or timeline announced (speculative).

items.title_zh: 英国在数据中心上对自由放任说不，避免重演美国式争议
items.title_en: UK rejects laissez-faire approach to data centres to avoid repeating US-style disputes
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据彭博社当地时间 11 日报道，英国财政大臣 John Healey 在同日进行的财政部特别委员会上表示， 该国在数据中心监管上不会采用美国式的自由放任策略 ，“不想看到美国的数据中心辩论在英国重演”。 整体上来看，美国对数据中心项目的监管相对粗放，这与容量不足的水电基础设施一道造成了一系列问题，引发公众和政界的强烈反对，已开始反过来阻碍对 AI 的投资。 图源：Pexels John Healey“准备对那些不能带来社区利益的数据中心说不”。他同时强调了主权 AI 基础设施对该国韧性与独立性的重要性。英国计划到 2030 年实现 6GW 的算力容量，这一水平是当前的 3 倍。 相关阅读： 《 谷歌英国数据中心遭近 5.5 万人联名反对，包括摩托骑手和昆虫保护者 》 《 微软取消 AI 相关合作，英国本土数据中心企业 Nscale 遭遇重大挫折 》 《 微软英国超大规模 AI 数据中心项目遇阻，遭 4 万居民联署反对 》 《 遏制投机性数据中心申请：英国能源市场监管机构拟设立并网保证金 》 《 英国水务协会警告：数据中心扩张将致用水量激增，政府未提前规划 》
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov. 13: Bloomberg reported on the 11th local time that UK Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey said at a Treasury Select Committee meeting the same day that the country will not adopt a US-style laissez-faire approach to data-centre regulation, and 'does not want to see the US data-centre debate repeated in the UK.' Overall, US regulation of data-centre projects is relatively loose, which, together with insufficient hydropower infrastructure capacity, has caused a series of problems and triggered strong public and political opposition, which has in turn begun to hinder investment in AI. John Healey is 'prepared to say no to data centres that do not bring community benefits.' He also stressed the importance of sovereign AI infrastructure to the country's resilience and independence. The UK plans to reach 6GW of compute capacity by 2030, three times the current level. Related reading: 'Google UK data centre opposed by nearly 55,000 signatories, including motorcyclists and insect conservationists'; 'Microsoft cancels AI-related cooperation, major setback for UK local data-centre company Nscale'; 'Microsoft UK hyperscale AI data-centre project blocked, opposed by 40,000 residents' joint letter'; 'Curbing speculative data-centre applications: UK energy regulator plans to set grid-connection deposits'; 'UK Water Industry Association warns data-centre expansion will cause water use to surge, government did not plan ahead.'

items.why_en: By factoring community benefits and sovereign AI infrastructure into data-centre regulation, the UK may shape how its 2030 6GW compute target is delivered (speculative).

items.title_zh: 寻找“下一个英伟达”：台积电拟设立 5 亿美元创投基金
items.title_en: Looking for the ‘next Nvidia’: TSMC plans $500 million venture fund
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据日经亚洲今天（13 日）上午报道，台积电计划设立一只规模 5 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 33.43 亿元人民币） 的创投基金，扶持有望成长为下一个英伟达或博通的芯片初创企业。 台积电业务开发及全球销售资深副总经理、副联席首席运营官张晓强透露，随着 AI 产业蓬勃发展，公司希望通过新基金扩大产业生态，并建立更加规范的投资机制。本周公布的新基金还可能投资供应商及其他上游合作伙伴，不再将投资对象局限于直接客户。 张晓强首次透露设立专门投资部门的原因：“我们认为， 是时候建立正式的投资机制了 。我们也希望扩大投资范围，不再只面向直接客户，而是借此发展更广泛的产业生态，包括供应商等上游合作伙伴。” 张晓强还谈到了台积电 向 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 各投最多 5 亿美元 （现汇率约合 33.43 亿元人民币） 背后的原因。“投资 Anthropic 或 OpenAI，可以形成 相互促进的良性循环 ，让整个产业生态更加丰富、健康，也有望进一步扩大规模。我们希望继续推动硅技术进步，满足未来的算力需求。” 新创投基金的 初始规模为 5 亿美元 （现汇率约合 33.43 亿元人民币） ，远高于台积电 2021 年设立的 2 亿美元 （现汇率约合 13.37 亿元人民币） 新兴企业基金。此前的基金主要帮助初创企业利用台积电的先进芯片制造技术。 张晓强指出，新创投部门的设立表明，台积电除了向全球芯片巨头提供代工服务，也希望 扶持半导体行业的新兴企业 。“我们不只是服务大客户。说起台积电，大家首先想到的可能是苹果、英伟达、AMD 和博通。没错，他们都是非常优秀的客户。但别忘了， 英伟达刚开始与我们合作时，也只是一家初创企业 。 我们不仅要支持今天的英伟达，也希望扶持未来的英伟达 。” 台积电承诺投入的资金总额最高达 17 亿美元 （现汇率约合 113.65 亿元人民币） ，涵盖 2021 年的新兴企业基金、新创投部门，以及对 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的投资计划。张晓强透露，原有基金的投资回报十分出色，如果有需要，台积电也不排除继续扩大新基金的规模。
items.summary_en: Nikkei Asia reported on November 13 that TSMC plans to set up a $500 million venture fund to support chip startups that could grow into the next Nvidia or Broadcom. Zhang Xiaoqiang, TSMC’s senior vice president of business development and global sales and deputy co-COO, said that with AI booming, the company hopes the new fund will expand its industry ecosystem and establish a more formal investment mechanism. The fund may also invest in suppliers and other upstream partners, not just direct customers. Zhang said a dedicated investment unit was set up because “it is time to establish a formal investment mechanism,” and TSMC wants to broaden its investment scope beyond direct customers to develop a wider ecosystem. He also explained TSMC’s plans to invest up to $500 million each in Anthropic and OpenAI: such investments can create a mutually reinforcing virtuous cycle, make the ecosystem richer and healthier, expand scale, and advance silicon technology to meet future computing demand. The new fund’s initial size is $500 million, far larger than TSMC’s $200 million emerging-enterprise fund set up in 2021; the earlier fund mainly helped startups use TSMC’s advanced chip manufacturing technology. Zhang noted that Nvidia was also a startup when it first worked with TSMC, and that TSMC wants to support not only today’s Nvidia but also the Nvidias of the future. TSMC has committed up to $1.7 billion in total, covering the 2021 fund, the new venture unit, and the planned investments in OpenAI and Anthropic; the original fund’s returns have been excellent, and TSMC may expand the new fund if needed.
items.why_zh: 推测：若基金按计划投向芯片初创及上游伙伴，可能强化台积电的产业生态影响力，但投资成效仍待观察。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the fund invests in chip startups and upstream partners as planned, it could strengthen TSMC’s ecosystem influence, but the investment results remain to be seen.

items.title_zh: 韩企雄心勃勃规划吉瓦级数据中心，但目前仅有兆瓦级规模设施落地
items.title_en: Korean Firms Plan Gigawatt-Scale Data Centers, but Only Megawatt-Scale Facilities Are Live So Far
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据韩媒 The Elec 今天（13 日）晚间报道，为满足日益增长的 AI 需求，KT、SK 电讯、Naver 和 NHN Cloud 等韩国企业纷纷提出建设吉瓦级数据中心的计划，但现有设施的容量仍 只有数十至数百兆瓦 。 相比之下，海外运营商的规模则早已突破 1GW，韩国企业可能因此陷入争夺客户不利、扩建计划延误的恶性循环。 截至 11 月 13 日，韩国企业公布的财报及季度报告显示，KT 和 SK 电讯运营的数据中心容量分别为 152MW 和 137MW，仅相当于各自 1GW 规划目标的 13% 至 15%。 KT 在第三季度财报电话会议上提出，到 2031 年新增 超过 1GW 的数据中心运营容量 。公司规划的新项目合计 911MW，但只有 200MW 的投资计划得到最终确认。 SK 电讯同样面临规模差距。公司计划通过 SK Horizon，将现有设施与蔚山、九老在建数据中心的 总容量扩大至 318MW 。这样的扩建进度，也让 SK 集团另行提出的 最高 15GW AI 数据中心建设目标 面临可行性质疑。 Naver 在江原道春川市和世宗市分别运营 GAK 春川、GAK 世宗两座数据中心。前者受电容量约 40MW，后者截至 2025 年 10 月的容量为 47MW，计划到 2029 年扩建至 130MW 以上。 对于这些韩国企业而言，要跻身拥有 1GW 容量的大型数据中心运营商行列， 仍需要投入巨额资金，并花费相当长的时间 。 海外的数据中心运营商 则迈入了吉瓦级规模 。美国 AI 云服务企业 CoreWeave 于当地时间 11 月 10 日公布的第三季度财报显示，投入运营的数据中心容量达到 1.7GW，通过与其他数据中心运营商签约取得的供电容量另有 4.6GW。 CoreWeave 的扩张有实际订单支撑。第三季度营收同比大增 168%，达到 4.9 万亿韩元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 245.1 亿元人民币） ，在手客户合同金额达到 177 万亿韩元 （现汇率约合 8,853.54 亿元人民币） 。 CoreWeave CEO 迈克尔 · 因特拉托在财报电话会议上透露，截至 2027 年底，正在洽谈的有效客户需求量达到公司现有可供应容量的 10 倍。 韩国企业在客户争夺方面也落后于海外竞争对手。Naver 在第三季度财报电话会议上公布，公司签下了一份 20MW 的供电容量合同。按照 Naver 与博枫等合作伙伴的计划，到 2028 年将提供 200MW 的数据中心容量，但目前签约的部分仅占规划规模的 10%。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 13: according to a report by Korean media The Elec that evening, to meet growing AI demand, Korean companies including KT, SK Telecom, Naver and NHN Cloud have all announced plans to build gigawatt-scale data centers, but existing facility capacity remains only tens to hundreds of megawatts. By contrast, overseas operators have long exceeded 1GW, so Korean firms may fall into a vicious cycle of weak customer acquisition and delayed expansion. As of Nov 13, filings and quarterly reports show KT and SK Telecom operate 152MW and 137MW of data center capacity respectively — only 13% to 15% of their respective 1GW targets. KT said on its Q3 earnings call that it plans to add more than 1GW of operational data center capacity by 2031; its planned new projects total 911MW, but only 200MW of investment has been finalized. SK Telecom faces a similar scale gap: it plans via SK Horizon to expand total capacity, including existing facilities and data centers under construction in Ulsan and Guro, to 318MW — a pace that also raises feasibility questions about SK Group's separately announced target of up to 15GW of AI data centers. Naver operates GAK Chuncheon and GAK Sejong in Gangwon-do's Chuncheon and Sejong respectively; the former has about 40MW of power capacity, the latter 47MW as of October 2025, with plans to expand to more than 130MW by 2029. For these Korean companies, joining the ranks of 1GW-scale data center operators still requires huge investment and considerable time. Overseas data center operators have entered the gigawatt era: US AI cloud provider CoreWeave's Q3 report, published Nov 10 local time, showed 1.7GW of operational data center capacity, plus another 4.6GW of power capacity contracted with other data center operators. CoreWeave's expansion is backed by actual orders: Q3 revenue rose 168% year on year to 4.9 trillion Korean won (IT之家 note: about 24.51 billion yuan at current exchange rates), with customer contract value of 177 trillion Korean won (about 885.354 billion yuan). CEO Michael Intrator said on the earnings call that, as of the end of 2027, active customer demand under negotiation is 10 times the company's currently available capacity. Korean companies also lag overseas rivals in winning customers: Naver announced on its Q3 earnings call that it signed a 20MW power capacity contract; under plans with partners including Brookfield, it aims to provide 200MW of data center capacity by 2028, but signed portions account for only 10% of the planned scale.
items.why_zh: 这组对比显示韩国主要运营商公布的吉瓦级规划与实际落地容量之间存在明显落差，而海外对手已进入吉瓦级并有订单支撑，可能影响其 AI 基础设施竞争力（推测，转述自韩媒报道，非官方确认）。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据韩媒 The Elec 今天（13 日）晚间报道，为满足日益增长的 AI 需求，KT、SK 电讯、Naver 和 NHN Cloud 等韩国企业纷纷提出建设吉瓦级数据中心的计划，但现有设施的容量仍 只有数十至数百兆瓦 。 相比之下，海外运营商的规模则早已突破 1GW，韩国企业可能因此陷入争夺客户不利、扩建计划延误的恶性循环。 截至 11 月 13 日，韩国企业公布的财报及季度报告显示，KT 和 SK 电讯运营的数据中心容量分别为 152MW 和 137MW，仅相当于各自 1GW 规划目标的 13% 至 15%。 KT 在第三季度财报电话会议上提出，到 2031 年新增 超过 1GW 的数据中心运营容量 。公司规划的新项目合计 911MW，但只有 200MW 的投资计划得到最终确认。 SK 电讯同样面临规模差距。公司计划通过 SK Horizon，将现有设施与蔚山、九老在建数据中心的 总容量扩大至 318MW 。这样的扩建进度，也让 SK 集团另行提出的 最高 15GW AI 数据中心建设目标 面临可行性质疑。 Naver 在江原道春川市和世宗市分别运营 GAK 春川、GAK 世宗两座数据中心。前者受电容量约 40MW，后者截至 2025 年 10 月的容量为 47MW，计划到 2029 年扩建至 130MW 以上。 对于这些韩国企业而言，要跻身拥有 1GW 容量的大型数据中心运营商行列， 仍需要投入巨额资金，并花费相当长的时间 。 海外的数据中心运营商 则迈入了吉瓦级规模 。美国 AI 云服务企业 CoreWeave 于当地时间 11 月 10 日公布的第三季度财报显示，投入运营的数据中心容量达到 1.7GW，通过与其他数据中心运营商签约取得的供电容量另有 4.6GW。 CoreWeave 的扩张有实际订单支撑。第三季度营收同比大增 168%，达到 4.9 万亿韩元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 245.1 亿元人民币） ，在手客户合同金额达到 177 万亿韩元 （现汇率约合 8,853.54 亿元人民币） 。 CoreWeave CEO 迈克尔 · 因特拉托在财报电话会议上透露，截至 2027 年底，正在洽谈的有效客户需求量达到公司现有可供应容量的 10 倍。 韩国企业在客户争夺方面也落后于海外竞争对手。Naver 在第三季度财报电话会议上公布，公司签下了一份 20MW 的供电容量合同。按照 Naver 与博枫等合作伙伴的计划，到 2028 年将提供 200MW 的数据中心容量，但目前签约的部分仅占规划规模的 10%。

items.title_zh: 黄仁勋出局。中国想从他那里得到什么？
items.title_en: Jensen Huang is out. What did China want from him?
items.summary_zh: 今天讨论英伟达的黄仁勋丑闻，事态发展很快，我们不得不在发布前几分钟紧急更新开场。黄仁勋刚刚辞去英伟达 CEO 职务，此前有关其绯闻——包括与一名据称的中国间谍的绯闻——的报道可能吞噬公司。随着事态发展，以及我们了解英伟达在黄仁勋之后如何重组，会有更多内容；毕竟他曾有约 60 名直接下属，而整个 AI 金融生态都流经该公司。这是纯正的 Decoder 素材。但就在两天前，我与布鲁金斯学会约翰·桑顿中国中心外交政策研究员 Kyle Chan 讨论了丑闻的真正核心：中国若在黄仁勋身边安插间谍，究竟想达成什么？美中 AI 冲突的真实状态如何，尤其是从中国视角看？Kyle 关于芯片和中国如何看待所谓 AI“竞赛”的回答很有启发性，但也许更有趣的是他对黄仁勋与特朗普关系的观察——因为中国可能最大的收获，是一个能在正确的人耳边低语的人。请注意，我们谈话时仍不知道黄仁勋会怎样。下面是 Kyle Chan 谈英伟达、中国与 AI 出口管制的未来。访谈为篇幅和清晰度做过轻微编辑。
